about.title: A bridge between Italian craftsmanship and international projects.
paragraphs: Opera Trade is built on Damiano Baldoni’s experience in the international furniture trade. We know every sector — homes, offices, yachts, hotels and contract — and every style, from classic to contemporary to fully bespoke.
Every request is a tailored search: the right manufacturer, the unique product, the competitive price. Then we stay at our client’s side until delivery.
